failure_condition: runner cannot load or wrapper cannot initialize
notes: route attempt failed before usable candidate sql could be produced

failure_condition: logical-plan substrate fails before sql extraction
notes: aligns to route or wrapper failure before candidate execution because parsing or ingestion failed

failure_condition: required input format contract or row materialization is missing
notes: input or ingestion contract failed before candidate sql production

failure_condition: raw output exists but executable output_sql cannot be extracted
notes: route attempted generation but did not produce executable candidate sql

failure_condition: candidate sql may have existed but retained artifact path is missing or incomplete
notes: required retained evidence is missing and cannot be safely recovered

failure_condition: row is explicitly unsupported by route or engine scope
notes: unsupported rows remain explicit in denominator accounting

failure_condition: row crosses a route or evaluation boundary that must remain explicit
notes: boundary rows must not be normalized away

failure_condition: required outcome or evidence is missing and cannot be classified safely
notes: use only when retained evidence is insufficient for safer classification
